fieldValues.title: F2 Meaning You Can Take / SRS 2.0
fieldValues.summary: A realistic SRS governance repository opens, validates, explains itself and renders offline as a self-contained semantic repository.
fieldValues.body:
## Track

F

## Actor

Independent user with no originating-service access

## Durable Artifact

Portable `.srs` export, generic readable fallback and independent conformance proof.

## Entry Criteria

- F1 evidence is green
- Archive, completeness and version-closure tests are defined

## Included Capabilities

- Define Meaning
- Preserve Meaning
- Present Facets
- Move and Reconcile

## Exclusions

- Editing and reintegration
- Cryptographic authority profiles
- Federation negotiation

## Walkthrough

Export an SRS-native governance repository or fixed governance fixture, disconnect from its originating service, then recover definitions, records, relations, provenance and a readable facet while accurately reporting missing evidence or unsupported semantics.

## Compatibility Promise

Frozen publications resolve their declared closure reproducibly and remain independent of live Views.

## Stable After

The public SRS boundary: Continuity becomes the default.

## Gaps

- SRS-web F2 portable-reader walkthrough: srs#384: Create and make a gate when the SRS-web repository runtime can open a portable archive without service access.
